text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus declares her intent to seize victory with all her might, and Hishi Akebono etches those words into her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two issue spirited challenges to one another, and the Takamatsunomiya Kinen starts with a bang!
